name: index-01
description: A composite index score with each domain's share and its biomarker Z-scores.

files.content:
"use client" import { InfoIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/tooltip" // The CBMI worked example. Each domain's Mean |Z| comes from its biomarker // Z-scores, Wd is its share of the total, and αd is its priority. // Score = αd × Mean |Z| × Wd. const domains = [ { name: "Cardiometabolic Risk", abbr: "CMR", alpha: 6, biomarkers: [ { name: "HbA1c", z: 7 }, { name: "TC", z: 3.338 }, { name: "LDL-C", z: 9.024 }, { name: "HDL-C", z: -2.43 }, ], }, { name: "Inflammatory Risk", abbr: "IR", alpha: 2, biomarkers: [ { name: "hs-CRP", z: 2.714 }, { name: "NLR", z: 2.4 }, { name: "IL-6", z: 3.712 }, ], }, { name: "Muscle-Cartilage Degeneration Risk", abbr: "MCDR", alpha: 2, biomarkers: [ { name: "CK-MM", z: 2.667 }, { name: "Aldolase A", z: 2.627 }, { name: "IGF-1", z: -2.107 }, { name: "Myostatin", z: 4.52 }, { name: "CTX-II", z: 2.736 }, ], }, { name: "Bone Turnover Risk", abbr: "BTR", alpha: 1, biomarkers: [ { name: "PTH", z: 2.824 }, { name: "Ca/P ratio", z: 2.5 }, { name: "Vitamin D", z: -2.263 }, { name: "Osteocalcin", z: -2.263 }, { name: "PINP", z: -2.687 }, ], }, { name: "Neurovascular Function Risk", abbr: "NVFR", alpha: 1, biomarkers: [ { name: "BDNF", z: -2.352 }, { name: "VEGF", z: 3.011 }, { name: "NOx", z: -2.11 }, ], }, ] const withMeanZ = domains.map((d) => ({ ...d, meanZ: d.biomarkers.reduce((sum, b) => sum + Math.abs(b.z), 0) / d.biomarkers.length, })) const totalMeanZ = withMeanZ.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.meanZ, 0) const scored = withMeanZ.map((d) => { const weight = d.meanZ / totalMeanZ return { ...d, weight, score: d.alpha * d.meanZ * weight } }) const total = scored.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.score, 0) const maxScore = Math.max(...scored.map((d) => d.score)) export default function Page() { return (
Composite Biological Musculoskeletal Index Five domains, 21 biomarkers. Each domain scores αd × Mean |Z| × Wd. The index is their sum.
{total.toFixed(2)} CBMI
    {scored.map((d) => (
  • {d.abbr}
    {d.score.toFixed(2)}
    • ))}
Domains Open a domain to see its biomarker Z-scores. {scored.map((d) => ( {d.name} ({d.abbr}) αd {d.alpha} · Wd {d.weight.toFixed(2)} {d.biomarkers.map((b) => ( ))}
Biomarker Z |Z|
{b.name} {b.z.toFixed(2)} {Math.abs(b.z).toFixed(2)}
))}
) }
